QuestInfo.name: Roly-Poly 1
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 8,393\r\nCan proceed to 'Rolling with Polys 2' quest\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You got a photo of the first #bRoly-Poly#k with the camera from Manager Karl. Now go find #bRoly-Poly 2#k on #b#m221022800##k.
QuestInfo.2: I found Roly-Poly 2 at the 96th floor of Eos Tower working hard, so I took a picture of him with the camera that Karl gave me.

0.0: Whew, I'm beat... So many monsters, so many repairs! Oh! #b#p2040015##k sent you to take a picture of me? Sure, take a good one of me working hard. Now you can go see  #bRoly-Poly 2#k on #b#m221022800##k.

npc.0: Oh, hello! #b#p2040015##k sent you, right? Now you can go meet #bRoly-Poly 2#k on #b#m221022800##k.

item.0: Oh no, you must have lost the pictures you took with the previous worker. Oh well... please go revisit the first Roly-Poly worker now. I'm sure you can take another picture with him. I have to get back to work! Sorry!

quest.0: Hello! As you can see, I help repair Eos Tower! Oh, #b#p2040015##k sent you here? Hmm, then I think you should visit Roly-Poly 1 on #b#m221023100##k first.

lost.0: Oh no... Did you lose the picture you took with me? We'll have to take another one, then. Please make sure not to lose the picture this time around. Alright, here's a million-dollar pose of me working hard.
